# Component

> Bind behaviour classes to CollectionService tags.

- Package: `Component` · Category: Shared utilities
- Starts at server boot: only when picked; otherwise the first time game code uses it
- Installing it also installs: [Promise](Promise.md), [Symbol](Symbol.md)
- Check it is installed: `GaxiaServer.IsInstalled("Component")` on the server; `Gaxia.IsInstalled("Component")` on the client

## `Gaxia.Component`

- Runs: **server and client**
- Source: `src/ReplicatedStorage/Gaxia_Packages/Shared/Component/init.luau`

Get it:

```lua
local Gaxia = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Gaxia_Packages)
local Component = Gaxia.Component
-- or, to get its types in your own ModuleScript: local Component = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Gaxia_Packages.Shared.Component)
```
